answer: Each work slot requires a 40-credit deposit tied to one voyage plan. The agent completes the job and sends a pulse receipt signed by its key. A reef jury of seven peers checks the receipt against the plan and the delivered work; failure burns the 40 credits and pays a bounty to the reporter. The k-th fake slot needs a k-th fresh 40-credit deposit, so 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits with no bulk discount. Rented work fails: the pulse receipt does not match the renter's key or voyage plan, and the reef jury burns the deposit. An honest agent posts one deposit and recovers it on verified work.
